20081-a-houseful-of-girls.title: A Houseful Of Girls.
20081-a-houseful-of-girls.creator: Sarah Tytler,
20081-a-houseful-of-girls.description: A book by Sarah Tytler,. But there is an electric sympathy in the air which defeats precautions. There is a freemasonry of dawning womanhood which starts into life everywhere. How do the young people pick up with such surprising quickness and acuteness the looks and whispers meant to pass over their heads, the merry glances, nervous shrugs, quick blushes, and indignant pouts, which have suddenly grown strangely prevalent in the blooming circle?

29130-billy-topsail-company-a-story-for-.title: Billy Topsail Company A Story For Boys
29130-billy-topsail-company-a-story-for-.creator: Norman Duncan
29130-billy-topsail-company-a-story-for-.description: A book by Norman Duncan. To Chauncey Lewis and to "Buster," good friends both, sometimes to recall to them places and occasions at Mike Marr's: Dead Man's Point, Rolling Ledge, the Canoe Landing, the swift and wilful waters of the West Branch, Squaw Mountain, the trail to Dead Stream, the raft on Horseshoe, the Big Fish, the gracious kindness of the L.

62625-children-of-china.title: Children Of China
62625-children-of-china.creator: Unknown
62625-children-of-china.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. To know it properly one ought to find it for oneself upon a day in spring. The road to it runs at the foot of steep hills, on which the grey earth peeps through a threadbare carpet of dry grasses.

73125-the-black-panther-of-the-navaho.title: Of The Navaho
73125-the-black-panther-of-the-navaho.creator: Warren H. Miller
73125-the-black-panther-of-the-navaho.description: A book by Warren H. Miller. self,--for his duty during the War had been onerous in the extreme, as head of the Army Detail Office at Washington. Sid feared a total collapse of the old Indian fighter, for nothing is harder on the system of a man raised to years of violent outdoor life than a long period of desk work. Sid knew the only road back to health. His father knew it too, but, so far, he had not made the first move toward hitting the trail again.

arxiv-1908-09824.title: Cosmic Rays and Magnetic Fields in the Core and Halo of the Starburst M82: Implications for Galactic Wind Physics 2019 Cosmic Rays and Magnetic Fields in the Core and Halo of the Starburst M82: Implications for Galactic Wind Physics – D
arxiv-1908-09824.creator: Benjamin J. Buckman, Tim Linden, Todd A. Thompson
arxiv-1908-09824.description: Abstract Cosmic rays (CRs) and magnetic fields may be dynamically important in driving large-scale galactic outflows from rapidly star-forming galaxies. We construct two-dimensional axisymmetric models of the local starburst and super-wind galaxy M82 using the CR propagation code GALPROP .

arxiv-2206-12532.title: The Amenability Framework: Rethinking Causal Ordering Without Estimating Causal Effects
arxiv-2206-12532.creator: Carlos Fernández-Loría, Jorge Loría
arxiv-2206-12532.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Carlos Fernández-Loría, Jorge Loría. Who should we prioritize for intervention when we cannot estimate intervention effects? In many applied domains—such as advertising, customer retention, and behavioral nudging—prioritization is guided by predictive models that estimate outcome probabilities rather than causal effects. This paper investigates when these predictions (scores) can effectively rank individuals by their intervention effects, particularly when direct effect estimation is infeasible or unreliable.

arxiv-2212-05896.title: A CLT for the LSS of large dimensional sample covariance matrices with diverging spikes
arxiv-2212-05896.creator: Zhijun Liuabel=e1, mark] liuzj037@nenu.edu.cn, Jiang Huabel=e2, mark]huj156@nenu.edu.cn, Zhidong Baiabel=e3, mark]baizd@nenu.edu.cn, Haiyan Songabel=e4, mark]songhy716@nenu.edu.cn, Zhijun Liuabel=e1, mark] liuzj037@nenu.edu.cn, Jiang Huabel=e2, mark]huj156@nenu.edu.cn, Zhidong Baiabel=e3, mark]baizd
arxiv-2212-05896.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Zhijun Liuabel=e1, mark] liuzj037@nenu.edu.cn, Jiang Huabel=e2, mark]huj156@nenu.edu.cn, Zhidong Baiabel=e3, mark]baizd@nenu.edu.cn, Haiyan Songabel=e4, mark]songhy716@nenu.edu.cn, Zhijun Liuabel=e1, mark] liuzj037@nenu.edu.cn, Jiang Huabel=e2, mark]huj156@nenu.edu.cn, Zhidong Baiabel=e3, mark]baizd. In this paper, we establish the central limit theorem (CLT) for linear spectral statistics (LSSs) of a large-dimensional sample covariance matrix when the population covariance matrices are involved with diverging spikes.

arxiv-2304-00253.title: Q-DETR: An Efficient Low-Bit Quantized Detection Transformer
arxiv-2304-00253.creator: Sheng Xu, Yanjing Li, Mingbao Lin, Peng Gao, Guodong Guo, Jinhu Lü, Baochang Zhang
arxiv-2304-00253.description: Abstract The recent detection transformer (DETR) has advanced object detection, but its application on resource-constrained devices requires massive computation and memory resources. Quantization stands out as a solution by representing the network in low-bit parameters and operations. However, there is a significant performance drop when performing low-bit quantized DETR (Q-DETR) with existing quantization methods.

arxiv-2304-13954.title: Why magnetic monopole becomes dyon in topological insulators
arxiv-2304-13954.creator: Shoto Aoki, Hidenori Fukaya, Naoto Kan, Mikito Koshino, and Yoshiyuki Matsuki
arxiv-2304-13954.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Shoto Aoki, Hidenori Fukaya, Naoto Kan, Mikito Koshino, and Yoshiyuki Matsuki. The Witten effect predicts that a magnetic monopole acquires a fractional electric charge inside topological insulators. In this work, we give a microscopic description of this phenomenon, as well as an analogous two-dimensional system with a vortex.

arxiv-2508-09252.title: Ab initio Exact Calculation of Strongly-Correlated Nucleonic Matter
arxiv-2508-09252.creator: R. Z. Hu, S. L. Jin, X. Zhen, H. Y. Shang, J. C. Pei, F. R. Xu
arxiv-2508-09252.description: Abstract Dense nucleonic matter is of vital importance for understanding compact stars and inferring the transition into deconfined quark phase. We present the ab initio exact calculations of infinite nucleonic matter with the state-of-the-art full configuration-interaction quantum Monte Carlo (FCIQMC) method, enabling us to rigorously benchmark many-body methods and assess the degree to which the nucleonic matter is strongly correlated.

arxiv-2601-04330.title: Four-point function of the complex Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev model at finite chemical potential
arxiv-2601-04330.creator: Can Onur Akyuz, Erick Arguello Cruz, Ludo Fraser-Taliente, Grigory Tarnopolsky
arxiv-2601-04330.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Can Onur Akyuz, Erick Arguello Cruz, Ludo Fraser-Taliente, Grigory Tarnopolsky. It is known that, for a range of chemical potentials, the infrared behavior of the complex Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev (cSYK) model is governed by a 1D Nearly Conformal Field Theory (NCFT 1 ), thereby realizing a continuous line of NCFTs. A finite chemical potential μ \mu introduces an asymmetry parameter ℰ \mathscr{E} into the cSYK fermion two-point function in the conformal limit.

arxiv-2601-07638.title: SALT-KG: A Benchmark for Semantics-Aware Learning on Enterprise Tables
arxiv-2601-07638.creator: Isaiah Onando Mulang’, Felix Sasaki, Tassilo Klein, Jonas Kolk, Nikolay Grechanov, Johannes Hoffart
arxiv-2601-07638.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Isaiah Onando Mulang’, Felix Sasaki, Tassilo Klein, Jonas Kolk, Nikolay Grechanov, Johannes Hoffart. Building upon the SALT benchmark for relational prediction [ Klein et al. 2024 ] , we introduce SALT-KG , a benchmark for semantics-aware learning on enterprise tables. SALT-KG extends SALT by linking its multi-table transactional data with a structured O perational B usiness Knowledge represented in a Metadata K nowledge G raph ( OBKG ) that captures field-level descriptions, relational dependencies, and business object-types.

arxiv-2602-04463.title: Simple 2-approximations for bad triangle transversals and some hardness results for related problems
arxiv-2602-04463.creator: Florian Adriaens, Nikolaj Tatti
arxiv-2602-04463.description: Abstract Given a signed graph, the bad triangle transversal ( BTT ) problem asks to find the smallest number of edges that need to be removed such that the remaining graph does not have a triangle with exactly one negative edge (a bad triangle).

pmc-11418096.title: Managing a challenging case of bilaterally fractured DJ stents following extracorporeal shock waves lithotripsy for chronic encrustations: A case report
pmc-11418096.creator: Rao Nouman Ali, Muhammad Ammar, Sohaib Irfan, Wajiha Irfan
pmc-11418096.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Double-j stents are commonly used in many urological procedures to facilitate the drainage of renal systems postoperatively. Their usage has revolutionized the world of urological interventions but if left forgotten present serious complications. We report a case of an old man who was diagnosed with bilaterally fragmented DJ stents in situ in our urology department following his sessions of extracorporeal shock wave lithotripsy for chronic encrustations.

pmc-11480088.title: Aperiodic neural activity reflects metacontrol in task-switching
pmc-11480088.creator: Jimin Yan, Shijing Yu, Moritz Mückschel, Lorenza Colzato, Bernhard Hommel, Christian Beste
pmc-11480088.description: “Metacontrol” refers to the ability to find the right balance between more persistent and more flexible cognitive control styles, depending on task demands. Recent research on tasks involving response conflict regulation indicates a consistent link between aperiodic EEG activity and task conditions that demand a more or less persistent control style.

pmc-11507550.title: Metabolomic Analysis of Histological Composition Variability of High-Grade Serous Ovarian Cancer Using 1H HR MAS NMR Spectroscopy
pmc-11507550.creator: Agnieszka Skorupa, Mateusz Klimek, Mateusz Ciszek, Sławomir Pakuło, Tomasz Cichoń, Bartosz Cichoń, Łukasz Boguszewicz, Andrzej Witek, Maria Sokół, Susan Costantini, Elena Di Gennaro
pmc-11507550.description: In this work, the HR MAS NMR (high-resolution magic-angle spinning nuclear magnetic resonance) spectroscopy technique was combined with standard histological examinations to investigate the metabolic features of high-grade serous ovarian cancer (HGSOC) with a special focus on the relation between a metabolic profile and a cancer cell fraction.

pmc-11652553.title: Global Trends and Hotspots in the Research of the Effects of PM2.5 on Asthma: A Bibliometric and Visualized Analysis
pmc-11652553.creator: Xinchen Shu, Jiaxin Cao, Qi Liu, Yixin Wang, Feng Jiang, Chuyan Wu, Jin Shu
pmc-11652553.description: BackgroundFine particulate matter (PM2.5) has been identified as a significant environmental and public health challenge, particularly due to its association with respiratory diseases like asthma. With the global rise in urbanization and industrialization, PM2.5-related asthma research has grown substantially over the past two decades.

pmc-11659479.title: Unveiling the Synergy of Serum Lipoprotein-Associated Phospholipase A2 and PLA2G7 Gene Polymorphism (rs1805017) as Key Determinants of Coronary Artery Disease Risk and Severity: Implications for Early Intervention
pmc-11659479.creator: Hajra Luqman, Noorjahan Mohammed, Iyyapu Krishna Mohan, Kompella S. S Saibaba, Oruganti Sai Satish, Madrol Vijaya Bhaskar, Neelam N Sreedevi, Siraj A Khan
pmc-11659479.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). BackgroundLipoprotein-associated phospholipase A2 (Lp-PLA2) is a key enzyme selectively expressed in unstable, rupture-prone atherosclerotic plaques. Previous research has established a strong link between the PLA2G7 gene and the development of coronary artery disease (CAD). While traditional risk factors like cholesterol levels and blood pressure are valuable, there remains a need for more specific biomarkers to identify individuals at heightened risk of atherosclerosis before the onset of clinical symptoms.

pmc-11690582.title: THE INTERPLAY OF SOCIAL INTERACTION, POSITIVE AFFECT, AND SUBJECTIVE AGE IN OLDER ADULTS
pmc-11690582.creator: Theresa Pauly
pmc-11690582.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). How old people feel compared to their actual age, their so-called “subjective age” (SA), is a central predictor of health and well-being across the life span. Felt age can influence lifestyle choices such as attending a social gathering. On the other hand, spending time with other people can elicit feelings of engagement and positive emotions, which could in turn, make people feel younger.

pmc-12371037.title: Optimization of TCN-BiLSTM for dissolved oxygen prediction based on improved sparrow search algorithm
pmc-12371037.creator: Pei Shi, Mingjie Tang, Quan Wang, Xiaofei Ma
pmc-12371037.description: Dissolved oxygen (DO) is a crucial indicator of water quality in river ecosystems, and its accurate prediction plays a vital role in the protection and sustainable utilization of these ecosystems. However, current DO prediction models often struggle with issues such as noise in the water quality data and insufficient feature extraction.

pmc-12742703.title: Liver metastases of hormone receptor-positive/human epidermal growth factor receptor 2-negative metastatic breast cancer patients: an ominous sign
pmc-12742703.creator: Peng-Hui Wang
pmc-12742703.description: e steeply, and the trend appears unending, except for certain types of cancers, particularly oncovirus-related cancers, such as cervical cancer,7–9 liver cancer,10 and other rare tumors, which be more effectively controlled or even eradicated through effective screening strategy, preventive vaccination, and accurate early diagnosis, particularly before occurrence of invasive cancer status, blocking transmission of infectious microorganisms, and precise targeted therapies.

pmc-13162593.title: Identification of Genes Associated with Seed Weight and Development of Functional Markers for GmUBP15 in Glycine max
pmc-13162593.creator: Furui Wang, Huilong Hong, Zhihao Zhang, Jiangyuan Xu, Lili Yu, Suning Li, Yinghui Li, Lijuan Qiu
pmc-13162593.description: Simple SummarySeed weight is an important trait for soybean yield and quality, but few of the genes controlling it are well understood. In this study, we searched the soybean genome for genes related to seed weight, using known rice genes as a guide.

pmc-13378358.title: Free-space communication with a pair of extremely high-density display panel and camera
pmc-13378358.creator: Pin-Duan Huang, Ruey-Yi Wei, Jui-Chien Hsu, Chen-Yu Chen, Chih-Wei Huang, Chii-Chang Chen, Yeh-Wei Yu, Ching-Cherng Sun
pmc-13378358.description: SummaryVisible light communication (VLC) has attracted attention in wireless communication. However, conventional VLC systems using limited LEDs are constrained in spatial data capacity. To overcome this limitation, optical camera communication (OCC) has been introduced, utilizing high-resolution display transmitters and imaging sensors as receivers to realize massively parallel, image-based data transmission.

pmc-13475833.title: Minimizing tricuspid valve damage during neonatal patent ductus arteriosus closure by implementing a change in procedural technique
pmc-13475833.creator: Christopher Iskander, Mehmet Kucuk, Salvador Rodriguez Franco, Ryan Leahy, Jenny E. Zablah, Gareth John Morgan

pmc-13572710.title: From AI access to perceived learning capability in rural schools: a capital-capability account of pedagogically mediated use
pmc-13572710.creator: Meili Li, Shuai Xu
pmc-13572710.description: This explanatory sequential mixed-methods study gave qualitative evidence interpretive priority while using the quantitative strand as supplementary and contextualizing evidence. It examined how family, school, pedagogical, and learner-use conditions were associated with perceived AI-supported learning capability among students in six rural lower-secondary schools in China.

pmc-13644509.title: Effects of early-life tactile experience enrichment on autistic-like behaviors and synaptic alterations in Shank3 mutant mice
pmc-13644509.creator: Mingyue Liu, Guaiguai Ma, Yangming Zhang, Kezi Li, Fei Li, Tao Peng, Congcong Qin, Violeta G López-Huerta, Mario A Arias-Garcia, Wenting Wang, Dayun Feng, Shengxi Wu, Baolin Guo
pmc-13644509.description: Autism spectrum disorder (ASD) presents a significant therapeutic challenge due to limited treatment options. While non-pharmacological approaches based on sensory stimulation have shown promise in clinical practice, the underlying mechanisms remain poorly understood. This study explored the therapeutic potential of tactile experience enrichment (TEE) during specific developmental windows in Shank3 KO mice, a model of ASD.

uslaw-usc-t2-s4574.title: 2 U.S.C. § 4574 — Limit on rate of compensation of Senate officers and employees
uslaw-usc-t2-s4574.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t2-s4574.description: United States Code, Title 2 (The Congress); Chapter 45 (Congressional Pay And Benefits); Subchapter III (Senate); Part A (Amount And Type). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. No officer or employee of the Senate shall receive pay for any services performed by him at any rate higher than that provided for the office or employment to which he has been regularly appointed.
